The booking service uses a queue-based hold system, not a time limit. Per [[ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue]], a hold is a position in a per-seat queue. The head of the queue may confirm; the rest wait. A hold expires only when:
- The user releases it explicitly, or  
- The head of the queue confirms and moves forward

**No hold expires on its own.** This replaced an earlier TTL-based system ([[ADR-001-hold-seats-with-ttl]]) that lost seats when users were still mid-checkout.

To prevent queue abuse, [[constraint-single-hold-per-user]] limits each user to one live hold at a time.

The booking service holds a seat **by placing the user in a queue** for that seat (not with a timer).

**Duration:** Indefinite. Holds no longer expire—they persist until the user explicitly releases the hold or confirms their booking. This approach replaced the earlier TTL system ([ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue](docs/project-knowledge/decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue.md)), which lost seats when the timer lapsed while users were still checking out.

The constraint [[constraint-single-hold-per-user]] prevents abuse: each user can hold only one seat at a time, so they can't park multiple holds indefinitely.

The booking service doesn't use a TTL for seat holds—instead, holds are queue positions that persist indefinitely until explicitly released.

From **[[decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue]]**: A hold is a position in a per-seat queue. The head of the queue may confirm; the rest wait. A hold is released only by the user or by confirmation of the head. No hold expires on its own.

The code (src/booking/reserve.js) confirms this: `holdSeat()` enqueues a hold with a position number, and `releaseHold()` removes it only when the user explicitly cancels or the front of the queue confirms their seat. This design was chosen to prevent users from losing seats mid-checkout due to a timer expiring, replacing an earlier TTL-based approach that caused 40 support tickets per week (as of 2026-05-01).

The [[constraints/constraint-single-hold-per-user]] constraint prevents users from parking unlimited holds: only one live hold per user is allowed.
